rules.alternatives: APRN certificates (issued after July 1, 2004) renew with evidence of current national certification or recertification; they expire when the RN license or the national certification expires, whichever is first. Practice requirement: 960 hours of advanced practice in the past 5 years (or an APRN program within 5 years); otherwise 45 h advanced pharmacology + 45 h role/population coursework and precepted practice.

topics.who: APRNs authorized to prescribe schedule II controlled substances with a DEA registration (opioid, substance use disorder or addiction CE)

rules.notes: No board contact-hour rule for APRN renewal; the 3 opioid/addiction hours each license renewal cycle (A.R.S. § 32-3248.02) count within any CE the board requires. Rules PDF read through the owner-approved browser (403 to scripts).
